quantization_spec.label: BF16 backbone + attention C4V8 forward QDQ, high-precision STE backward; branch shorthand W16A16C4V8
quantization_spec.W_A: Weights and model backbone remain BF16. No W4 or A8 global model quantization.
quantization_spec.C_meaning: Attention Cube GEMM operands Q/K/V and unnormalized within-tile P use NVFP4 QDQ. QK and PV are executed as FP32 dequantized reference matmuls, not native4-bit kernels.

C_scales.block: 16 consecutive last-axis elements, each row separately; zero tail padding
C_scales.upper_scale: One FP32 scale per full logical last-axis row, independently per token/head; not global tensor scale
C_scales.scope_examples: Q/K/V group feature axis; P group key axis within original128-key tile; V not transposed into a different nativeGEMM grouping

quantization_spec.V_meaning: Attention Vector-boundary MXFP8 QDQ includes max/sum reductions and running-state updates; not only final probability/output casting.

V_format.block: 32 consecutive last-axis values within one query/head row
V_format.scale: E8M0, s=2^clamp(ceil(log2(amax/448)),-127,127), allzero block s=1; exact bit construction/threshold comparison, not an approximate pow/log kernel
V_format.mask: Causal -inf is out-of-band, excluded from amax and restored; mask gradient zero
V_format.scalar_states: Each row scalar is its own one-element block padded with zeros, not grouped across query tokens

quantization_spec.V_reduction: Adjacent binary max/sum tree, odd level identity-padding (-inf/0); initial input and EACH level requantized toMXFP8. Running max merge, denominator multiply and add separately requantized. This is an experiment-defined operation order; MXFP8 format alone does not prescribe it.
quantization_spec.online_softmax: S=MX(Q4@K4^T/sqrt(D)) after causal masking; m=MX(max(m_old,MX_tree_max(S))); alpha=MX(exp(MX(m_old-m))); P8=MX(exp(MX(S-m))); L=MX(MX(L_old*alpha)+MX_tree_sum(P8)); O=MX(MX(O_old*alpha)+MX(NVFP4(P8)@V4)); final=MX(exact signed FP32 RNE(O/L)), then cast output to input BF16/FP32.
quantization_spec.P8_P4_distinction: P8 supplies denominator tree; NVFP4(P8) supplies PV only. Do not substitute P4 in denominator.
high_precision_exceptions: FP32 underlying elementary operations before boundary QDQ, including exp
FP32 dequantized GEMM accumulation and ordinary score scaling
FP32 upper-scale estimation/exact division and structural masks/indices
High-precision identity-STE/autograd backward; not quantized backward or nativeNVFP4 training

execution_policy.GQA: repeat KV heads logically; same grouping perhead
execution_policy.decode: Final-position one-query inference with no requires_grad uses staged decode; exact logical128-key quantization boundaries retained; same-length requests batched, mixed lengths remain separate
execution_policy.backward: Query-tile recomputation stores original Q/K/V; FP32 replay/accumulation then inputdtype cast; Post closed-form identity-STE Jacobian; no higher-order gradient claim
